title: Config Schemas for Job Node Types
description:
Create Zod validation schemas and TypeScript types for the 3 new job node types.

**File (NEW):** `dashboard/src/components/workflow/job/schemas.ts`

Three Zod schemas:
- `agentTaskSchema`: label (required), topic (required), prompt (string), adapterId (string), priority (select), maxInputTokens (number), maxOutputTokens (number), maxTotalTokens (number), deadlineMs (number), allowSummarization (boolean), allowRetrieval (boolean), memoryId (string), contextMode (string), timeout (string), retryMax (number)
- `packActionSchema`: label (required), packId (required), topic (string), capability (string), input (JSON string), riskTags (string[]), requires (string[]), timeout (string), retryMax (number)
- `toolCallSchema`: label (required), capability (required), prompt (string), riskTags (string[]), topic (string), priority (string), timeout (string), retryMax (number), labels (Record<string, string>)

Export inferred TypeScript types: `AgentTaskConfig`, `PackActionConfig`, `ToolCallConfig`.

**Pattern:** Follow existing Zod schema style in `NodeConfigPanel.tsx` (jobSchema, approvalSchema, etc.). Use `z.coerce.number()` for numeric fields, `z.string().optional()` for optional strings.
definitionOfDone: agentTaskSchema validates topic required, prompt optional, numeric token fields with min/max
packActionSchema validates packId required, JSON input string
toolCallSchema validates capability required, labels as Record<string,string>
TypeScript types exported: AgentTaskConfig, PackActionConfig, ToolCallConfig
